C0949.title: Jiangsu Police Dismantle Live-Streaming Platform Linked to Gambling
C0949.summary: In July 2020, police in Yancheng, Jiangsu discovered that the 'Mifan' live-streaming platform was involved in match-fixing gambling. Streamers posed as 'betting experts' to attract viewers and directed them to add agents of overseas gambling sites on WeChat, channeling traffic to these sites. The platform and streamers split the tips from the overseas gambling sites on a 50-50 basis. By October 20
